reports.headline: The Final Screening
reports.body: The theater {dir} of the village {dist} has posted a new bill: tonight only, HUMAN EARTHWORM. Nobody put it there. The projector in the booth is loaded and waiting, and {name} says that when {they} touched it, it was warm, as though it had only just stopped.

reports.headline: Somebody Must Stop the Film
reports.body: Every night the film at the theater {dir} of here {dist} runs a little longer, and every morning someone else is missing. The projector waits in the booth. {name} says whoever starts it will be seen by whatever is on the screen.
